title: Announced starters — official evidence, not inferred replacements
note: Each row quotes an official NFL.com page and links it. A replacement that no official page names is left out of this table entirely; the depth-chart walking on the Team Availability page is labelled as derived and is not reproduced here.

announced.quote: QB Carson Beck will start Sunday's game against the Rams, per head coach Mike LaFleur. This will be Beck's first career start in the NFL after he was selected in the third round of the 2026 draft.

QB Deshaun Watson will start Sunday against the Texans, the team announced Wednesday. Watson cleared concussion protocol before Cleveland's Week 9 game but was inactive as Shedeur Sanders got the start in the loss to New Orleans.

K Harrison Butker will continue to handle kicking duties for Kansas City for its Week 10 game against the Falcons, head coach Andy Reid said. Butker missed a 51-yard field goal in Week 9 and is 12 of 19 on field goal attempts this season.

Head coach Kevin O'Connell told reporters on Wednesday that it is "too early" to commit to Kirk Cousins as their starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Packers. The Vikings traded a 2027 third-round draft pick to the Raiders on Tuesday for Cousins.

Drew Lock has no injury designation and will start Sunday for the Seahawks against the host Las Vegas Raiders, coach Mike Macdonald said Friday. Lock is filling in for the injured Sam Darnold and set to make his second straight start and his third overall this season.
Jalen Milroe will be Seattle's backup.
QB Sam Darnold (ribs/quadricep) did not practice on Wednesday. Darnold has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders. (Official Week 10 injury report game status: Out.)
